posts.title: MIT SLIC: AI Analog Circuit Design With Smaller Models
posts.description: MIT SLIC: AI researchers have introduced an AI technique that could make analog circuit design more accessible to engineering teams. Called SLIC, the method trains smaller language models to optimize circuits through repeated simulations rather than depending entirely on expensive, cloud-based AI systems.
